query:
SELECT vt.id, vt.type, vt.name, vt.isRequired, vo.id as optionId, vo.name as optionName, vo.priceModifier 
FROM variationTypes vt 
LEFT JOIN variationOptions vo ON vt.id = vo.variationTypeId 
WHERE vt.productId = 990001 
ORDER BY vt.id, vo.id;
